problem: Choose the context cards that enter a prompt

Scores: hybrid_union top-1 40%, top-3 67%, recall 73% within its 6 files; vector_bge_small (a baseline, plain cosine) top-1 67%, top-3 73%; idf_docstrings top-1 40%, top-3 67%.
